label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): alert-TP — the insecure randomness is used to generate a session ID/remember-me token (rememberMeKey) which is stored in a cookie and used for authentication purposes. Alert 2 (java/xss): alert-TP — the user-provided value from the cookie is directly concatenated into the HTML response without proper encoding, making it vulnerable to XSS. Both alerts are exploitable on their respective paths, driving the case label to TP.

evidence.note: Insecure randomness source (new java.util.Random().nextFloat()) used to generate rememberMeKey
User-provided value from cookie directly concatenated into HTML response, vulnerable to XSS
